latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Self-Distill Skill (人格元数据框架):

- Introduces a structured multi-level framework inspired by Jungian psychology and cognitive development.
- Defines three structural layers (Ego, personal unconscious, collective unconscious) and four archetypal components (persona, anima/animus, shadow, self).
- Maps out attitude (I/E), cognitive functions (T/F/S/N), and an 8-function/16-type system (MBTI simplified).
- Details methodologies for personality data collection, quality assessment, and inference, with a step-by-step analytical workflow.
- Provides formats and logic for standardized personality output, with guidance for diverse applications including individual analysis, self-awareness, and relationship diagnostics.
- Emphasizes evidence-based inference, dynamic development, and integration of both positive and shadow aspects.
